title: Fixed-Size Active Statistical Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.27389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Variance reduction techniques improve the efficiency of drawing conclusions from data. Recent proposals for variance-reduction use two complementary techniques to reduce variance: incorporating machine learning predictions into estimators and weighted sampling. A popular weighted sampling algorithm is Poisson Sampling (PS), which independently flips a biased coin at each unit and includes all heads in the sample. A fundamental flaw with PS is that it has a random sample size, which presents practical challenges and introduces variance into the estimator. We show that a fixed-size alternative, known in survey sampling as Conditional Poisson Sampling (CPS), is a drop-in replacement for PS on general multivariate Z-estimation problems, which include convex M-estimation considered in prior work. translated_title: 固定样本量的主动统计推断
translated_abstract: 方差缩减技术可以提高从数据中得出结论的效率。最近的方差缩减方案采用两种互补的技术来降低方差：将机器学习预测纳入估计器，以及加权抽样。一种流行的加权抽样算法是泊松抽样（Poisson Sampling, PS），它对每个单元独立地掷一枚有偏硬币，并将所有正面结果纳入样本。PS 的一个根本缺陷在于其样本量是随机的，这既带来了实际操作上的挑战，也给估计器引入了额外的方差。我们证明了一种固定样本量的替代方法——在抽样调查领域被称为条件泊松抽样（Conditional Poisson Sampling, CPS）——可以作为 PS 的直接替代方案，应用于一般的多变量 Z 估计问题，其中涵盖了先前工作中所考虑的凸 M 估计。值得注意的是，我们证明 CPS 的渐近方差不劣于 PS，并且在存在预测模型的现实场景中可以显著更优。
tldr: 该论文提出用固定样本量的条件泊松抽样（CPS）替代样本量随机的泊松抽样（PS），证明 CPS 是一般多变量 Z 估计问题（包括凸 M 估计）中 PS 的直接替代方案，且其渐近方差不劣于 PS，在现实场景中甚至可显著更优。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that fixed-size Conditional Poisson Sampling (CPS) is a drop-in replacement for Poisson Sampling in general multivariate Z-estimation problems, with asymptotic variance no worse than—and often substantially better than—PS.
